column1: # What the brotli 1.2.0 CLI decodes each recorded stream to: `brotli -c -q Q -w W`
# of the inputs, then `brotli -d -c` of the result, which equalled its input, recorded
# binary: 8 KiB of compiled aterm machine code; random: 8 KiB of xorshift64*; runs: runs
# of 1 to 65000 bytes; empty; one: the byte 0xa5. Columns: stream, decoded length, SHA-256.
